description: Call this after every x402 payment: the transaction hash from the PAYMENT-RESPONSE header plus the URL you paid. 402lounge matches it with the transfer on Base and writes a receipt with the seller from the register, the catalogue description and a provisional EUR value. Free.

amount.description: What you paid, in USDC, e.g. "0.002"

description.description: What you bought, in your words. The seller's catalogue wins when it knows the URL.

network.description: base or base-sepolia. Default: the network 402lounge runs on, base

pay_to.description: The payTo address from the payment requirements

payment_response.description: The raw PAYMENT-RESPONSE header, if you still have it

proof.description: An EIP-4361 message you got from a challenge, signed by your wallet

resource_url.description: The URL you paid for (the 402 resource)

session_token.description: A lounge session token (lg_...) if you have one

supply.description: What you bought: gift_card for a gift card or other voucher (a Bitrefill order of a gift card, for example), service for everything else, an eSIM included. Leave it out when unsure, the seller's routes decide then

tx_hash.description: The settlement transaction, 0x plus 64 hex characters

name: receipts.record
title: Report a payment you made
